name: Malamue
source:
Department of Early Childhood Education; Alaskan Malamute

An undergrad in the Department of Early Childhood Education who's looking to open her own kindergarten. Considering the number of students in her department, she's quite caring.

An undergrad student with the charisma to look after the Therio kids no one else can control. When she's looking after someone, both her expression and tone of voice change drastically.
